title: Review: MIME 2026-06-15
notes:
Review confidence: 25% chance of missed bug.
Least confident areas: (1) smime-tree ECDH key agreement paths — curve validation, cofactor handling, and KDF parameter negotiation are complex and only partially testable without adversarial fixtures; (2) mime-tree parse.rs mail-parser delegation — bugs in mail-parser's handling of edge-case MIME structures would pass through silently; (3) yencoding multi-part reassembly gap/overlap semantics under concurrent writers.
Would raise confidence if: (a) adversarial CMS fuzzing corpus run against smime-tree decrypt/verify; (b) cross-validation of mime-tree parse output against Python email.parser on a corpus of 1000+ real-world messages; (c) property-based tests for uuencoding/yencoding roundtrip on random binary data with random chunking.
